schema: llm-sizer/validation v1 — measured decode speeds and peak memory from public reports, used to fit and to judge the speed model (scripts/llm-sizer/fit_speed.py). split: train rows fit the architecture costs and runtime factors; holdout rows (the gemma-4 family and the omlx contributor's short-context submissions, whole submissions; see holdout_rule) are never fitted on; report rows are informational only (grade C, accelerated, or excluded for the reason given). grade: A = reproducible benchmark output or stated methodology, B = a named person's measurement with hardware stated, C = secondary reporting. kv_bits is the cache precision the runtime used (16 unless stated). Chip profiles (t0, effective bandwidth) come from benchmarks.json, never from this file. Memory rows carry peak_reported (the number as published), peak_unit (GiB, GB, or unknown), peak_metric (what was measured) and peak_gb normalised to decimal GB; weights_gb is the file size of the build measured. Every row's active_params_b and kv_bytes_per_token_8bit must match the catalog record it names (validation-catalog.test.ts).
holdout_rule: family == gemma-4, or contributor == omlx with no row past 8K, by submission_id; the two oMLX M5 Max submissions that run past 8K (Qwen 3.8 27B to 64K, Nemotron 3 Super at 32K) train the M5-generation MLX context cost, the only long-context M5 rows there are; since 0.16 the oMLX community rows (contributor omlx-community, 2026-10) train on the chips of the 128 GB comparison (M5 Max, M4 Max, M2 Ultra) and hold out on the others (M5 Pro, M3 Ultra, the 64-core M1 Ultra, M5 Ultra), whole submissions; the 48-core M1 Ultra and the one plain M5 Ultra Flash Next session are report rows; since 0.17 the oMLX community rows scraped on 2026-10-19 (one row per model, chip and GPU bin, the median of the plain sessions within 10 % of that group's median, every run id in the note; a group validation.json already covers at 4K is not added) train on gpt-oss-20b, gpt-oss-120b and Qwen3-Coder-Next and hold out whole families, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and Gemma 4, and every M5 Ultra row
